author: Karl Rock
description:
Is Balochistan off-limits to foreigners? Visiting this part of Pakistan can be incredibly difficult, with travel restrictions, permits and security arrangements making it much harder to explore than other parts of the country.

If you're a foreigner hoping to visit Balochistan, do your research well in advance. Contact the relevant Pakistani authorities to find out which permits you need, and consider working with an experienced local tour operator who can help arrange the necessary permissions and security arrangements.

Requirements vary depending on your itinerary and the current security situation, so don't book anything until you've confirmed that your trip is permitted.

Have you ever visited Balochistan? Share your experience in the comments!
title: Is Balochistan Off-Limits to Foreigners?
